counting_rules: Pool, actually consumed training examples, prediction test problems, planning problems, planner repeats, candidates and control steps are separate counters.
All train/validation/test reset IDs are disjoint. Repeated seeds on the same test problem do not increase independent problem counts.
Damage conditions do not substitute for object diversity. Only scalar simulation-count comparisons are claimed across the different tasks.
Fresh training checkpoints do not inherit the existing real-robot evidence. The deployed seed27 checkpoint remains a separately identified model.
Formal protocol and hashes must be frozen before collecting test evidence. Pilot data are excluded.
Retain every registered method and seed, including regressions. Completion does not depend on obtaining favorable results.
